tasks.short: Evaluate actual patient data and test findings to diagnose mental disorder.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify relevant actual patient history, data and test findings
Analyze and evaluate actual findings, alternative explanations and limitations
Diagnose the nature or extent of mental disorder and identify unresolved diagnostic questions
Write and check the actual diagnostic conclusion, evidence and uncertainty
Save the checked actual diagnostic note

tasks.design: Configure native dated-result and history views in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, to reduce source navigation. Retain all diagnostic source reading, analysis, differential judgement and actual diagnostic writing; separately save the checked note without a model diagnosing or inferring missing findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diagnostic sources may require repeated navigation across clinical record sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native result and history views can expose source records without interpreting them.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnostic meaning depends on context, conflicting findings and uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: The psychiatrist judges alternative explanations and remains accountable for the diagnosis.
tasks.altitude: Less record finding; diagnostic authority and clinical responsibility are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical record views can expose dated results and history while diagnostic interpretation remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is evaluation of actual available data through a diagnostic note, not administering tests or communicating a new treatment order.

Prior clinical and laboratory work supplies patient ID, dated actual findings, source author and test references. The psychiatrist verifies identity, completeness and context in s1; missing or mismatched sources need manual retrieval there.
Only source navigation changes. Shares and reduction are provisional; existing native views and runtime earn no new benefit.
The existing diagnostic-note accuracy check covers the final save, without extra self-approval work. The fully retained 1 percent save is schema granularity.
research_questions: Does a diagnostic case sample reveal source navigation the current native system can remove?

incremental.description: Check diagnostic-source view links and access changes

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked actual diagnostic note with source evidence and uncertainty

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional 15-unit source navigation at 50 percent saves 7.5 points minus 0.5 upkeep = seven. Half eligible navigation gives 3.25. Actual data evaluation, diagnosis, writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design an individualised psychiatric care plan using appropriate treatments.

steps.what: Establish actual patient needs, preferences, clinical findings and treatment constraints
Evaluate appropriate treatment alternatives, interactions, feasibility and patient-specific limits
Design the individual care plan, goals, treatment choices and review arrangements
Write and correct the final care plan from the psychiatrists actual treatment decisions

loop.purpose: Format the psychiatrists selected plan into native care-plan headings
loop.input: Psychiatrist-authored treatment choices, goals, actual patient preferences and review arrangements
loop.output: Draft plan wording preserving the psychiatrists exact decisions
loop.check: Psychiatrist checks every treatment, negation, timing, attribution and qualification; rejects invented commitments and omissions against their authored plan
loop.stop: Missing decision content, ambiguity or two unsuccessful corrections returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native plan headings handle structure first; varied clinician-authored rationale still needs reviewed wording

steps.what: Save the checked final individual care plan

tasks.design: Keep needs assessment, treatment comparison and individual plan design human. Test native {OTHER} care-plan templates first; only where actual prose remains, trial bounded formatting of the psychiatrists authored decisions, correct the full final meaning and separately save the plan without issuing prescriptions or referrals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual care decisions may require repeated prose formatting into the clinical plan form.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded clinician-note drafting can format already selected content under full semantic review.
tasks.still_hard: A coherent plan must balance actual needs, preferences, treatment risks and practical availability.
tasks.human_edge: The psychiatrist chooses treatments and remains responsible for their patient-specific fit.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less plan wording; treatment choices and authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded clinical drafting can format a clinicians authored plan content but requires full correction and cannot establish appropriate treatment.

assumptions: Boundary is designing and recording a care plan, not executing prescriptions, referring patients or sending external instructions.

The psychiatrist captures actual patient context in s1 and authors selected treatments, goals, responsibilities, timings and review conditions in s3. No structured decisions or clinical rationale are provided free by a model.

Native forms are tested first. Full wording capture and semantic checking remain in s4 retained time; no ambient recording is assumed. Use only an authorised clinical environment with established access.

Shares and reduction are provisional. Existing drafting earns no benefit. The final full-plan accuracy check is in actual writing, not new approval ceremony; the fully retained 1 percent save is schema granularity.
research_questions: Can native headings remove enough work without a model?
Do corrected drafts preserve exact clinician choices and all patient-specific limitations?

already_counted.description: Actual plan wording and full semantic correction within the writing step

incremental.description: Maintain clinical plan headings and inspect recurring drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete clinician-checked final individual care plan and exact treatment decisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional 19-unit actual plan writing retains 70 percent, saving 5.7 points minus one upkeep = 4.7. Half eligible prose gives 2.85 minus one = 1.85. Needs assessment, treatment evaluation, design and native save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inform authorised relatives or guardians about actual patient conditions or treatment.

steps.what: Verify patient wishes, recipient identity and actual authority for the proposed discussion
Review actual patient condition and treatment facts relevant to the permitted discussion
inputs: actual patient condition and treatment record

steps.what: Advise or inform the authorised guardian or relative and respond to actual concerns
Write and check actual recipient, disclosed information, concerns and agreed follow-up
Save the checked actual family discussion note

tasks.design: Use native relevant-record views in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, to shorten factual source navigation. Retain disclosure-authority checks, actual sensitive family discussion and fresh outcome writing; save the actual checked note separately without generating a family message or inferring permission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Facts needed for a permitted discussion may be spread across clinical record sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native related-record views can reduce factual navigation while leaving permission and explanation human.
tasks.still_hard: Patient wishes, recipient understanding and sensitive questions require actual judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The psychiatrist explains conditions with care while respecting the patients actual wishes and disclosure scope.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation; disclosure and clinical responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical record views can show relevant dated facts without determining disclosure authority or replacing family discussion.

assumptions: Boundary is a permitted actual discussion and its clinical note, not automatic external letters or patient permission collection by a model.

Prior clinical work supplies actual condition and treatment facts; the psychiatrist verifies recipient identity, patient wishes and actual authority in s1. Missing authority is resolved manually before s3, never inferred from a relationship label.
Missing source links require manual navigation in s2. Actual discussion findings and concerns are captured only in s4; no transcript or structured outcome is assumed.
Shares are provisional. Native views are tested first; existing views earn no benefit. Actual note checking covers its fully retained 1 percent save, which is schema granularity.
research_questions: Can native source navigation improve while actual permission and sensitive discussion checks remain intact?

incremental.description: Check factual-view links and clinical access changes

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked actual family discussion note including recipient and disclosed scope

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional ten-unit factual navigation at 50 percent saves five points minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Half eligible navigation gives two. Permission verification, actual advice, fresh note writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach, learn, attend professional events and research psychiatric disorders.

steps.what: Find current psychiatric literature and relevant education opportunities using selected native searches
Teach actual psychiatric concepts and respond to learners questions
Take continuing education classes and critically examine actual course material
Attend conferences or seminars and discuss actual psychiatric research findings
Conduct actual research and interpret evidence on mental, emotional or behavioural disorders
Write and check actual learning notes and research findings for the intended publication
Save the checked actual learning notes and final manuscript
outputs: saved actual learning and research records

steps.what: Submit the checked final research findings to the selected publication outlet

tasks.design: Configure native topic searches in {OTHER}, the licensed literature and professional programme library. Retain actual teaching, classes, conference participation, research, source reading and substantive publication writing; separately save the checked records and submit the checked final manuscript through {OTHER}, the publication portal, without treating submission as acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Discovery of relevant current sources and learning opportunities can repeat manual searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic searches can reduce discovery work; they do not perform learning or research.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding disorders and producing credible research require actual intellectual and professional work.
tasks.human_edge: The psychiatrist critically relates evidence, teaching and professional exchange to clinical questions.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less discovery effort; research and teaching authority are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native library and professional programme searches support topic-based discovery without replacing participation, research or publication writing.

assumptions: Boundary is this broad professional-development portfolio, including actual teaching, study, event participation and actual research writing and submission. The provisional mix is illustrative and must be replaced by the psychiatrists actual work mix.

The psychiatrist supplies topic choices within s1 and verifies returned sources manually in its retained effort. Publishers and programme organisers provide indexed records; missing metadata needs ordinary manual searching.

Actual research evidence is generated and interpreted within s5; no study data, transcript or publishable finding is assumed free. s6 includes actual notes, manuscript writing, source checks and required author checks of its final version.

Native searches are tested first; existing searches earn no benefit. No savings are claimed for teaching, study, research or manuscript writing. The two fully retained 1 percent actions are schema granularity and existing final accuracy and destination checks cover their exact versions.
unknowns: Actual mix of teaching, study, conference and research work
research_questions: Does the actual work portfolio contain repeated discovery that native searches can remove without changing substantive work?

incremental.description: Maintain selected source and programme topic searches

approvals.approved_version: s6 complete checked actual notes and final research manuscript with source references
s6 complete checked final manuscript and intended publication outlet

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional five-unit discovery step at 60 percent reduction saves three points minus 0.5 upkeep = 2.5. Half eligible discovery gives one. Actual teaching, learning, conference exchange, research, writing, save and manuscript send retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Specific native retrieval and corrected plan documentation may shrink; actual diagnosis, treatment planning, family advice and scholarly work remain human.
skills_to_grow: Review drafted plan meaning against actual treatment decisions
Maintain current clinical and scholarly source searches
role.ambitious_version: A psychiatrist who prepares reliable source-linked clinical records while preserving actual patient care and professional judgement.
